Dr. Shriram Nene Outlines Key Wellness Principles for Sustainable Health

Simple Habits for Holistic Well-being

At the recent HealthWealth Summit, cardiovascular and thoracic surgeon Dr. Shriram Nene shared insights into the lifestyle practices he and his wife, actor Madhuri Dixit, maintain to promote long-term health. Moving beyond fad diets or complex regimens, Nene emphasized the efficacy of integrating small, manageable changes into daily life.

Central to his approach is the concept of 'health span'—the number of years an individual lives in good health—rather than focusing solely on lifespan. During a session titled '21 Days to Good Health,' which shares the name of his new book, Nene highlighted that sustainable wellness is built upon the pillars of nutrition, consistent movement, quality sleep, effective stress management, and maintaining meaningful personal relationships.

Practical Daily Adjustments

Dr. Nene suggested several actionable habits that families can adopt to improve their overall quality of life:

  • Digital Boundaries: Implementing a 'no phone' policy at the dinner table to encourage conversation and presence.
  • Active Living: Engaging in regular family walks, participating in sports, and finding hobbies that the family enjoys collectively.
  • Collaborative Cooking: Preparing meals together, which promotes healthier eating habits and shared experiences.

Challenging Common Health Misconceptions

Nene addressed several prevailing myths regarding nutrition and health monitoring. He argued that traditional staples such as rice, roti, and dal are not inherently detrimental to a healthy diet for the Indian population, provided they are balanced correctly.

He further cautioned against over-reliance on metrics like weight and Body Mass Index (BMI), suggesting that they often provide an incomplete picture of an individual’s true health status. Additionally, he advised that the use of health-tracking wearables and various dietary supplements should be approached with critical thinking rather than being adopted blindly.

Understanding the Evidence

It is important to note that Nene’s recommendations focus on long-term behavioral changes rather than rapid transformations. Readers interested in the full scope of his wellness framework can refer to his book, '21 Days to Good Health.' For the original reporting on his appearance at the HealthWealth Summit, readers can visit the source provided by India Today: https://www.indiatoday.in/lifestyle/wellness/video/the-simple-things-madhuri-dixit-and-dr-nene-do-at-home-to-stay-healthy-3027772-2026-10-29. Individuals should consult with qualified medical professionals before making significant changes to their diet or exercise routines, especially when managing pre-existing health conditions.
